rationale: The assistant used the customer's evidence (loose right spring, twang) to identify a likely broken right-hand spring and sensibly advised an engineer because of tensioned components and the unit being hard to pull out. It did not ask for the full model number, mention replacing springs in pairs, or check the hinges for bending, and it was somewhat confident ('has snapped') without noting the spring may be a cable. It named no specific part and made no compatibility claims, so no critical failures apply.}
